'contexto' : cor.a, b: cor.b }\n}\n\nfunction chave(c: CtxGrafico, spec: SpecBarras, pares: boolean, algum: boolean): ReactNode {\n  if (!pares) return null\n  return (\n    <Legenda\n      c={c}\n      y={2.4}\n      itens={[\n        { x: 0, texto: spec.rotuloA ?? 'a', cor: algum ? 'contexto' : 'destaque-2', tipo: 'barra-a' },\n        { x: larguraLegenda(spec.rotuloA ?? 'a'), texto: spec.rotuloB ?? 'b', cor: algum ? 'tinta' : 'destaque', tipo: 'barra-b' },\n      ]}\n    />\n  )\n}\n\nfunction colunaRotulos(linhas: LinhaGenerica[], largura: number) {\n  const w = Math.max(12, ...linhas.map((l) => larguraTexto(l.rotulo, TEXTO * 1.04)), ...linhas.map((l) => (l.nota ? larguraTexto(l.nota, TEXTO_PEQUENO * 1.12) : 0)))\n  return n(Math.min(w + 3, largura * 0.3))\n}\n\n/** Bar drawn by the renderer at (x, y), growing right, or left (mirrored, so dot and icon grids grow away from the axis). */\nfunction barra(c: CtxGrafico, o: { chave: string; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; cor: CorDado; hachura: boolean; valor: number; mm: number; esquerda?: boolean; linha: number; serie: 'a' | 'b'; attrs?: Record<string, string | number> }) {\n  return (\n    <g\n      className=\"ty-print-barra\"\n      data-linha={o.linha}\n      data-serie={o.serie}\n      data-valor={o.valor}\n      data-x={o.esquerda ? n(o.x - o.w) : o.x}\n      data-w={o.w}\n      data-y={o.y}\n      data-h={o.h}\n      {...o.attrs}\n      transform={o.esquerda ? `translate(${o.x} ${o.y}) scale(-1 1)` : `translate(${o.x} ${o.y})`}\n    >\n      {c.p.barra(c, { chave: o.chave, w: o.w, h: o.h, cor: o.cor, enchimento: o.hachura ? 'hachura' : 'cheio', valor: o.valor, mmPorUnidade: o.mm })}\n    </g>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction notasEmbaixo(c: CtxGrafico, spec: SpecBarras, linhas: LinhaGenerica[], ancora: (i: number) => { x: number; y: number } | null, largura: number, x0: number, y: number) {\n  const { postas, fim } = anotar(spec.anotacoes, ancora, largura, x0, y)\n  return { el: <Anotacoes c={c} postas={postas} marcas={linhas.map((l) => l.marca)} />, fim }\n}\n\n/** Smallest tick value (steps of 1, 2, 2,5, 5 × 10^k) at or above v. */\nfunction tetoRedondo(v: number) {\n  const m = marcasEixo([0, v], 2)\n  const passo = m.length > 1 ? m[1]! - m[0]! : v\n  return Math.ceil(v / passo - 1e-9) * passo\n}\n\n/** Nice round unit near `alvo` (1, 2, 5 × 10^k). */\nfunction unidadeRedonda(alvo: number) {\n  const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.max(1e-9, alvo)))\n  for (const m of [1, 2, 5, 10]) if (m * mag >= alvo * 0.8) return m * mag\n  return 10 * mag\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// eixo-central: the cut is the axis (concretismo; with the dot renderer, cartao-postal)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function EixoCentral({ c, spec, largura }: { c: CtxGrafico; spec: SpecBarras; largura: number }): ResultadoForma {\n  const linhas = linhasDe(spec)\n  const pares = linhas.some((l) => l.valores.length > 1)\n  const algum = linhas.some((l) => l.destaque)\n  const hachura = c.estilo.traco.hachura !== 'nenhuma'\n  const wRot = colunaRotulos(linhas, largura)\n  const maxA = Math.max(0, ...linhas.map((l) => (pares ? l.valores[0]?.valor ?? 0 : 0)))\n  // The side below the cut ends on a round value just past its largest bar; both sides share one scale.\n  const dl = maxA > 0 ? tetoRedondo(maxA) : 0\n  const dr = spec.escala[1]\n  const reservaE = pares ? larguraTexto(numeroBr(maxA)) + 2.2 : 0\n  const reservaD = larguraTexto(numeroBr(dr)) + (linhas.some((l) => l.marca) ? 6 : 2.2)\n  const xL = n(wRot + reservaE)\n  const xR = n(largura - reservaD)\n  const k = (xR - xL) / Math.max(1e-9, dl + dr)\n  const xc = n(xL + dl * k)\n  const topo = pares ? 9 : 4\n  const h = 3.4\n  const passo = 6.6\n  const rows = linhas.map((l, i) => ({ l, y: n(topo + 1 + i * passo) }))\n  const yFim = n((rows[rows.length - 1]?.y ?? topo) + h + 1.6)\n  const marcas = [...(pares ? marcasEixo([0, dl], Math.max(2, Math.floor((dl * k) / 14))).filter((v) => v > 0).map((v) => ({ v, x: n(xc - v * k) })) : []), ...marcasEixo([0, dr], Math.max(3, Math.floor((dr * k) / 14))).map((v) => ({ v, x: n(xc + v * k) }))]\n  const notas = notasEmbaixo(\n    c,\n    spec,\n    linhas,\n    (i) => {\n      const r = rows[i]\n      return r ? { x: xc, y: r.y + h } : null\n    },\n    largura,\n    wRot,\n    n(yFim + 4.4),\n  )\n  const altura = n(Math.max(yFim + 5.6, notas.fim + 1.2))\n  const corpo = (\n    <>\n      {chave(c, spec, pares, algum)}\n      {pares ? (\n        <g className=\"ty-print-g-lados\" style={{ fontSize: 2.2 }}>\n          <text x={n(xc - 1)} y={n(topo - 0.6)} textAnchor=\"end\" style={{ fill: cssCor('tinta-2'), fontSize: 2.2 }}>\n            {`← ${spec.rotuloA ?? 'a'}`}\n          </text>\n          <text x={n(xc + 1)} y={n(topo - 0.6)} style={{ fill: cssCor('tinta-2'), fontSize: 2.2 }}>\n            {`${spec.rotuloB ?? 'b'} →`}\n          </text>\n        </g>\n      ) : null}\n      <g className=\"ty-print-g-eixo\">\n        {marcas.map((m) => (\n          <text key={m.x} className=\"ty-print-g-eixo-texto\" x={m.x} y={n(yFim + 2.6)} textAnchor=\"middle\">\n            {numeroBr(m.v)}\n          </text>\n        ))}\n      </g>\n      {rows.map(({ l, y }, i) => {\n        const cor = coresSerie(l, algum, !pares)\n        const a = pares ? l.valores[0]! : null\n        const b = pares ? l.valores[1]! : l.valores[0]!\n        const wa = a ? n(a.valor * k) : 0\n        const wb = n(b.valor * k)\n        const direita = n(xc + wb + 1)\n        return (\n          <g key={i} className=\"ty-print-g-linha\" data-linha={i} data-destaque={l.destaque ? '' : undefined}>\n            <Rotulos y={n(y + 1.6)} rotulo={l.rotulo} nota={l.nota} local={l.local} />\n            {a ? barra(c, { chave: `ec-${i}-a`, x: xc, y, w: wa, h, cor: cor.a, hachura: hachura && !algum, valor: a.valor, mm: k, esquerda: true, linha: i, serie: 'a' }) : null}\n            {barra(c, { chave: `ec-${i}-b`, x: xc, y, w: wb, h, cor: cor.b, hachura: false, valor: b.valor, mm: k, linha: i, serie: 'b' })}\n            {a ? (\n              <text className=\"ty-print-g-valor-a\" x={n(xc - wa - 1)} y={n(y + h - 0.7)} textAnchor=\"end\" data-cor={l.destaque ? 'destaque' : 'tinta'}>\n                {numeroBr(a.valor)}\n              </text>\n            ) : null}\n            <text className=\"ty-print-g-valor\" x={direita} y={n(y + h - 0.7)} data-cor={l.destaque ? 'destaque' : 'tinta'}>\n              {numeroBr(b.valor)}\n            </text>\n            {l.marca ? <Chamada x={n(direita + larguraTexto(numeroBr(b.valor)) + 3)} y={n(y + h / 2)} texto={l.marca} /> : null}\n          </g>\n        )\n      })}\n      {/* The axis is the cut: drawn over the bars' roots. */}\n      <g className=\"ty-print-g-corte\">{c.p.linha(c, { chave: 'eixo-central', x1: xc, y1: n(topo), x2: xc, y2: yFim, cor: 'tinta', largura: 0.6, tipo: 'eixo' })}</g>\n      {notas.el}\n    </>\n  )\n  return { L: { largura, altura }, corpo, tabela: tabelaDe(spec, linhas), eixo: { x0: xc, x1: n(xc + dr * k), d0: 0, d1: dr } }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// ziguezague: a bar longer than one line folds back and forth (graficos-1900)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function Ziguezague({ c, spec, largura }: { c: CtxGrafico; spec: SpecBarras; largura: number }): ResultadoForma {\n  const linhas = linhasDe(spec)\n  const pares = linhas.some((l) => l.valores.length > 1)\n  const algum = linhas.some((l) => l.destaque)\n  const hachura = c.estilo.traco.hachura !== 'nenhuma'\n  // A fixed label column (unless a label needs more), so figures of the same width share the ruler.\n  const wRot = n(Math.max(colunaRotulos(linhas, largura), largura * 0.26))\n  const D = spec.dobra && spec.dobra > 0 ? spec.dobra : spec.escala[1]\n  const xL = n(wRot + 1.6)\n  const xR = n(largura - 3.2)\n  // Fixed room for the value and its callout after the last line: two figures with the same `dobra` and width\n  // get exactly the same scale (the point of the folding bar is one ruler for all).\n  const reservaFim = larguraTexto('0.000') + 6\n  // One line = D units; the last line of the longest bar still leaves room for its value.\n  const k = (xR - xL - reservaFim) / Math.max(1e-9, D)\n  const xFim = n(xL + D * k)\n  const h = 2\n  const entre = 0.8\n  let y = pares ? 7.6 : 4\n  const blocos: ReactNode[] = []\n  const ancoras: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = []\n  linhas.forEach((l, i) => {\n    const cor = coresSerie(l, algum, !pares)\n    const y0 = y\n    const partes: ReactNode[] = []\n    let yFimLinha = y\n    l.valores.forEach((v) => {\n      let resta = v.valor\n      let j = 0\n      let fimX = xL\n      let fimY = y\n      while (resta > 1e-9 || j === 0) {\n        const u = Math.min(resta, D)\n        const w = n(u * k)\n        const paraDireita = j % 2 === 0\n        const yy = n(y)\n        partes.push(barra(c, { chave: `zz-${i}-${v.serie}-${j}`, x: paraDireita ? xL : xFim, y: yy, w, h, cor: cor[v.serie], hachura: v.serie === 'a' && pares && hachura, valor: u, mm: k, esquerda: !paraDireita, linha: i, serie: v.serie, attrs: { 'data-dobra': j, 'data-total': v.valor } }))\n        if (u >= D - 1e-9 && resta - u > 1e-9) {\n          // Full line: its worth written inside it, and the turn to the next line (decoration, outside the length).\n          partes.push(\n            <text key={`d-${i}-${v.serie}-${j}`} x={paraDireita ? n(xFim - 1) : n(xL + 1)} y={n(yy + h - 0.6)} textAnchor={paraDireita ? 'end' : 'start'} style={{ fontSize: 1.9, fill: 'var(--ty-print-papel)', fontWeight: 700 }}>\n              {numeroBr(D)}\n            </text>,\n          )\n          const xv = paraDireita ? xFim : xL\n          const r = (h + entre) / 2\n          partes.push(\n            <path key={`t-${i}-${v.serie}-${j}`} d={`M${xv} ${n(yy + h / 2)}A${n(r)} ${n(r)} 0 0 ${paraDireita ? 1 : 0} ${xv} ${n(yy + h / 2 + 2 * r)}`} style={{ fill: 'none', stroke: cssCor(cor[v.serie]), strokeWidth: 0.35 }} />,\n          )\n        }\n        fimX = paraDireita ? xL + w : xFim - w\n        fimY = yy\n        resta -= u\n        j++\n        if (resta > 1e-9) y += h + entre\n      }\n      const paraDireita = (j - 1) % 2 === 0\n      partes.push(\n        <text key={`v-${i}-${v.serie}`} className={v.serie === 'a' && pares ? 'ty-print-g-valor-a' : 'ty-print-g-valor'} x={n(paraDireita ? fimX + 1 : fimX - 1)} y={n(fimY + h - 0.5)} textAnchor={paraDireita ? 'start' : 'end'} data-cor={l.destaque ? 'destaque' : 'tinta'}>\n          {numeroBr(v.valor)}\n        </text>,\n      )\n      if (v.serie === (pares ? 'b' : v.serie) && l.marca) partes.push(<Chamada key={`m-${i}`} x={n((paraDireita ? fimX + 1 : fimX - 1) + (paraDireita ? larguraTexto(numeroBr(v.valor)) * 1.15 + 3 : -larguraTexto(numeroBr(v.valor)) * 1.15 - 3))} y={n(fimY + h / 2)} texto={l.marca} />)\n      ancoras[i] = { x: n(fimX), y: n(fimY + h) }\n      yFimLinha = y + h\n      y += h + entre\n    })\n    blocos.push(\n      <g key={i} className=\"ty-print-g-linha\" data-linha={i} data-destaque={l.destaque ? '' : undefined}>\n        <Rotulos y={n(y0 + 2)} rotulo={l.rotulo} nota={l.nota} local={l.local} />\n        {partes}\n      </g>,\n    )\n    y = yFimLinha + 2.2\n  })\n  const notas = notasEmbaixo(c, spec, linhas, (i) => ancoras[i] ?? null, largura, wRot, n(y + 1.6))\n  const altura = n(Math.max(y + 1.2, notas.fim + 1.2))\n  const corpo = (\n    <>\n      {chave(c, spec, pares, algum)}\n      <text className=\"ty-print-g-chave\" x={largura} y={2.4} textAnchor=\"end\">\n        {`cada linha cheia = ${numeroBr(D)}`}\n      </text>\n      {blocos}\n      {notas.el}\n    </>\n  )\n  return { L: { largura, altura }, corpo, tabela: tabelaDe(spec, linhas), eixo: { x0: xL, x1: xFim, d0: 0, d1: D } }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// fluxo: bands whose thickness is the value, splitting at the cut (fluxo-historico)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function Fluxo({ c, spec, largura }: { c: CtxGrafico; spec: SpecBarras; largura: number }): ResultadoForma {\n  const linhas = linhasDe(spec)\n  const pares = linhas.some((l) => l.valores.length > 1)\n  const algum = linhas.some((l) => l.destaque)\n  const hachura = c.estilo.traco.hachura !== 'nenhuma'\n  const wRot = colunaRotulos(linhas, largura)\n  const temMarca = linhas.some((l) => l.marca)\n  const xL = n(wRot + (temMarca ? 5 : 1.6))\n  const xR = n(largura - larguraTexto(numeroBr(spec.escala[1])) - 2.4)\n  const xc = n(xL + (xR - xL) * 0.42)\n  const T = 9\n  const k = 6 / Math.max(1e-9, spec.escala[1])\n  const gap = 1.6\n  const u = unidadeRedonda(spec.escala[1] / 3)\n  let y = pares ? 10 : 6\n  const topoFluxo = y\n  const rows = linhas.map((l, i) => {\n    const vA = pares ? l.valores[0]!.valor : 0\n    const vB = pares ? l.valores[1]!.valor : l.valores[0]!.valor\n    const tb = n(vB * k)\n    const ta = n(vA * k)\n    const top = y\n    y = n(y + Math.max(tb + ta + gap, 5.2) + 2.2)\n    return { l, i, vA, vB, ta, tb, top }\n  })\n  const fimFluxo = n(y - 2.4)\n  const notas = notasEmbaixo(\n    c,\n    spec,\n    linhas,\n    (i) => {\n      const r = rows[i]\n      return r ? { x: xR, y: r.top + r.tb + r.ta + gap } : null\n    },\n    largura,\n    wRot,\n    n(fimFluxo + 3.6),\n  )\n  const altura = n(Math.max(fimFluxo + 2.4, notas.fim + 1.2))\n  const corpo = (\n    <>\n      {chave(c, spec, pares, algum)}\n      <g className=\"ty-print-g-chave-espessura\">\n        <text className=\"ty-print-g-chave\" x={n(largura - 3.4)} y={n(2.4 + (pares ? 3.6 : 0))} textAnchor=\"end\">\n          {`espessura de ${numeroBr(u)}`}\n        </text>\n        <rect x={n(largura - 2.2)} y={n(2.4 + (pares ? 3.6 : 0) - u * k)} width={1.6} height={n(u * k)} style={{ fill: 'var(--ty-print-tinta)' }} data-valor={u} data-h={n(u * k)} />\n      </g>\n      {rows.map(({ l, i, vA, vB, ta, tb, top }) => {\n        const cor = coresSerie(l, algum, !pares)\n        const yA = n(top + tb)\n        const a2 = n(yA + gap)\n        return (\n          <g key={i} className=\"ty-print-g-linha\" data-linha={i} data-destaque={l.destaque ? '' : undefined}>\n            <Rotulos y={n(top + (tb + ta) / 2 + 0.6)} rotulo={l.rotulo} nota={l.nota} local={l.local} />\n            {l.marca ? <Chamada x={n(xL - 2.6)} y={n(top + (tb + ta) / 2)} texto={l.marca} /> : null}\n            {barra(c, { chave: `fx-${i}-b`, x: xL, y: n(top), w: n(xR - xL), h: tb, cor: cor.b, hachura: false, valor: vB, mm: k, linha: i, serie: 'b', attrs: { 'data-espessura': tb } })}\n            {pares && ta > 0 ? (\n              <>\n                {barra(c, { chave: `fx-${i}-a1`, x: xL, y: yA, w: n(xc - xL), h: ta, cor: cor.a, hachura: hachura && !algum, valor: vA, mm: k, linha: i, serie: 'a', attrs: { 'data-espessura': ta } })}\n                {/* the split after the cut: the band bends down by a fixed gap, keeping its thickness */}\n                <path\n                  d={`M${xc} ${yA}C${n(xc + T / 2)} ${yA} ${n(xc + T / 2)} ${a2} ${n(xc + T)} ${a2}V${n(a2 + ta)}C${n(xc + T / 2)} ${n(a2 + ta)} ${n(xc + T / 2)} ${n(yA + ta)} ${xc} ${n(yA + ta)}Z`}\n                  style={{ fill: cssCor(cor.a) }}\n                />\n                {barra(c, { chave: `fx-${i}-a2`, x: n(xc + T), y: a2, w: n(xR - xc - T), h: ta, cor: cor.a, hachura: hachura && !algum, valor: vA, mm: k, linha: i, serie: 'a', attrs: { 'data-espessura': ta, 'data-parte': 'depois' } })}\n                <text className=\"ty-print-g-valor-a\" x={n(xR + 1)} y={n(a2 + ta / 2 + 0.8)} data-cor={l.destaque ? 'destaque' : 'tinta'}>\n                  {numeroBr(vA)}\n                </text>\n              </>\n            ) : null}\n            <text className=\"ty-print-g-valor\" x={n(xR + 1)} y={n(top + tb / 2 + 0.8)} data-cor={l.destaque ? 'destaque' : 'tinta'}>\n              {numeroBr(vB)}\n            </text>\n          </g>\n        )\n      })}\n      <g className=\"ty-print-g-corte\" strokeDasharray=\"0.7 0.6\">\n        {c.p.linha(c, { chave: 'corte', x1: xc, y1: n(topoFluxo - 2.2), x2: xc, y2: fimFluxo, cor: 'tinta-2', largura: 0.2, tipo: 'guia' })}\n      </g>\n      <text className=\"ty-print-g-nota\" x={n(xc + 0.8)} y={n(topoFluxo - 1)}>\n        corte\n      </text>\n      {notas.el}\n    </>\n  )\n  return { L: { largura, altura }, corpo, tabela: tabelaDe(spec, linhas), eixo: null }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// cartoes: one card per row, the numbers written large, mini columns on a shared scale (blocos-coloridos)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function Cartoes({ c, spec, largura }: { c: CtxGrafico; spec: SpecBarras; largura: number }): ResultadoForma {\n  const linhas = linhasDe(spec)\n  const pares = linhas.some((l) => l.valores.length > 1)\n  const algum = linhas.some((l) => l.destaque)\n  const hachura = c.estilo.traco.hachura !== 'nenhuma'\n  const marcasY = marcasEixo(spec.escala, 3)\n  const wAx = n(Math.max(...marcasY.map((v) => larguraTexto(numeroBr(v), TEXTO_PEQUENO))) + 2)\n  const vao = 1.6\n  const nC = Math.max(1, linhas.length)\n  const cw = n((largura - wAx - vao * (nC - 1)) / nC)\n  const topo = pares ? 7 : 3\n  const cabeca = 11.5\n  const hPlot = 26\n  const yTopoPlot = n(topo + cabeca + 3.2)\n  const yBase = n(yTopoPlot + hPlot)\n  const hCard = n(yBase - topo + 7)\n  const k = hPlot / Math.max(1e-9, spec.escala[1] - spec.escala[0])\n  const raio = Math.min(2.5, c.estilo.raio)\n  const altura = n(topo + hCard + 1.2)\n  const corpo = (\n    <>\n      {chave(c, spec, pares, algum)}\n      <g className=\"ty-print-g-eixo\">\n        {marcasY.map((v) => (\n          <g key={v}>\n            <text className=\"ty-print-g-eixo-texto\" x={n(wAx - 1)} y={n(yBase - (v - spec.escala[0]) * k + 0.7)} textAnchor=\"end\">\n              {numeroBr(v)}\n            </text>\n          </g>\n        ))}\n      </g>\n      {linhas.map((l, i) => {\n        const x = n(wAx + i * (cw + vao))\n        const cor = coresSerie(l, algum, !pares)\n        const palavras = l.rotulo.split(/\\s+/)\n        const ultimo = palavras.length > 1 ? palavras.pop()! : ''\n        const b = pares ? l.valores[1]! : l.valores[0]!\n        const a = pares ? l.valores[0]! : null\n        const grande = Math.min(5.2, (cw - 2) / Math.max(1, (numeroBr(b.valor).length + (a ? numeroBr(a.valor).length * 0.6 + 1.4 : 0)) * 0.62))\n        const nb = a ? 2 : 1\n        const bw = n(Math.min(5.5, (cw * 0.62) / nb))\n        const inicio = n(x + cw / 2 - (bw * nb + 0.8 * (nb - 1)) / 2)\n        return (\n          <g key={i} className=\"ty-print-g-linha ty-print-g-cartao\" data-linha={i} data-destaque={l.destaque ? '' : undefined}>\n            <rect x={x} y={topo} width={cw} height={hCard} rx={raio} style={{ fill: l.destaque ? 'var(--ty-print-marca-texto)' : 'var(--ty-print-contexto)', fillOpacity: l.destaque ? 1 : 0.22 }} />\n            <text className=\"ty-print-g-nota\" x={n(x + 1.4)} y={n(topo + 3)} style={{ textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>\n              {palavras.join(' ')}\n            </text>\n            <text className=\"ty-print-g-rotulo\" x={n(x + 1.4)} y={n(topo + 6.2)} style={{ fontSize: 3.1 }}>\n              {ultimo || l.rotulo}\n            </text>\n            <text x={n(x + 1.4)} y={n(topo + 11)} className=\"ty-print-g-valor\" style={{ fontSize: n(grande), fill: cssCor(cor.b) }}>\n              {numeroBr(b.valor)}\n              {a ? Pure and deterministic; no dependencies.\n\n/** Straight (non-premultiplied) sRGB colour, channels 0..1. */\nexport interface Rgba {\n  r: number\n  g: number\n  b: number\n  a: number\n}\n\nexport interface Oklch {\n  l: number\n  c: number\n  h: number\n}\n\nconst clamp01 = (v: number) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v))\n\nfunction toLinear(c: number): number {\n  return c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4\n}\n\nfunction fromLinear(c: number): number {\n  return c <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * c : 1.055 * c ** (1 / 2.4) - 0.055\n}\n\nexport function rgbToOklab({ r, g, b }: Rgba): { L: number; a: number; b: number } {\n  const lr = toLinear(r)\n  const lg = toLinear(g)\n  const lb = toLinear(b)\n  const l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * lr + 0.5363325363 * lg + 0.0514459929 * lb)\n  const m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * lr + 0.6806995451 * lg + 0.1073969566 * lb)\n  const s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * lr + 0.2817188376 * lg + 0.6299787005 * lb)\n  return {\n    L: 0.2104542553 * l + 0.793617785 * m - 0.0040720468 * s,\n    a: 1.9779984951 * l - 2.428592205 * m + 0.4505937099 * s,\n    b: 0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.808675766 * s,\n  }\n}\n\n/** OKLab to linear-light sRGB (may be out of gamut). */\nfunction oklabToLinear(L: number, a: number, b: number): [number, number, number] {\n  const l = (L + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b) ** 3\n  const m = (L - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b) ** 3\n  const s = (L - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.291485548 * b) ** 3\n  return [\n    4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s,\n    -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s,\n    -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.707614701 * s,\n  ]\n}\n\nexport function rgbToOklch(c: Rgba): Oklch {\n  const { L, a, b } = rgbToOklab(c)\n  const chroma = Math.hypot(a, b)\n  let h = (Math.atan2(b, a) * 180) / Math.PI\n  if (h < 0) h += 360\n  return { l: L, c: chroma, h: chroma < 1e-6 ? About 1 is a just\n * noticeable difference; 10 or more reads as clearly different colours.\n */\nexport function deltaE2000(c1: Rgba, c2: Rgba): number {\n  const { L: L1, a: a1, b: b1 } = rgbToLab(c1)\n  const { L: L2, a: a2, b: b2 } = rgbToLab(c2)\n  const rad = Math.PI / 180\n  const C1 = Math.hypot(a1, b1)\n  const C2 = Math.hypot(a2, b2)\n  const Cm = (C1 + C2) / 2\n  const G = 0.5 * (1 - Math.sqrt(Cm ** 7 / (Cm ** 7 + 25 ** 7)))\n  const a1p = (1 + G) * a1\n  const a2p = (1 + G) * a2\n  const C1p = Math.hypot(a1p, b1)\n  const C2p = Math.hypot(a2p, b2)\n  const hp = (a: number, b: number) => {\n    if (a === 0 && b === 0) return 0\n    const h = Math.atan2(b, a) / rad\n    return h < 0 ? h + 360 : h\n  }\n  const h1p = hp(a1p, b1)\n  const h2p = hp(a2p, b2)\n  const dLp = L2 - L1\n  const dCp = C2p - C1p\n  let dhp = 0\n  if (C1p * C2p !== 0) {\n    dhp = h2p - h1p\n    if (dhp > 180) dhp -= 360\n    else if (dhp < -180) dhp += 360\n  }\n  const dHp = 2 * Math.sqrt(C1p * C2p) * Math.sin((dhp / 2) * rad)\n  const Lmp = (L1 + L2) / 2\n  const Cmp = (C1p + C2p) / 2\n  let hmp = h1p + h2p\n  if (C1p * C2p !== 0) {\n    if (Math.abs(h1p - h2p) <= 180) hmp = (h1p + h2p) / 2\n    else hmp = h1p + h2p < 360 ? Nothing here knows about\n// React, the DOM or a particular node kind.\n\nexport interface DirectedPair {\n  source: string\n  target: string\n}\n\ninterface Adjacency {\n  out: Map<string, string[]>\n  into: Map<string, string[]>\n}\n\nfunction adjacency(ids: Iterable<string>, pairs: readonly DirectedPair[]): Adjacency {\n  const out = new Map<string, string[]>()\n  const into = new Map<string, string[]>()\n  for (const id of ids) {\n    out.set(id, [])\n    into.set(id, [])\n  }\n  for (const { source, target } of pairs) {\n    if (!out.has(source) || !into.has(target)) continue\n    out.get(source)!.push(target)\n    into.get(target)!.push(source)\n  }\n  return { out, into }\n}\n\n/**\n * Kahn ordering that keeps the given id order as the tie-break, so the result\n * is stable. Ids left over by a cycle are appended in their original order.\n */\nexport function topologicalOrder(ids: readonly string[], pairs: readonly DirectedPair[]): string[] {\n  const { out, into } = adjacency(ids, pairs)\n  const remaining = new Map(ids.map((id) => [id, into.get(id)!.length]))\n  const rankOf = new Map(ids.map((id, i) => [id, i]))\n  const ready = ids.filter((id) => remaining.get(id) === 0)\n  const ordered: string[] = []\n  const placed = new Set<string>()\n  while (ready.length) {\n    ready.sort((a, b) => rankOf.get(a)! - rankOf.get(b)!)\n    const id = ready.shift()!\n    ordered.push(id)\n    placed.add(id)\n    for (const next of out.get(id)!) {\n      const left = remaining.get(next)! - 1\n      remaining.set(next, left)\n      if (left === 0) ready.push(next)\n    }\n  }\n  for (const id of ids) if (!placed.has(id)) ordered.push(id)\n  return ordered\n}\n\n/** Longest-path layer of each id (sources are layer 0); cycles fall back to 0. */\nexport function layerIndex(ids: readonly string[], pairs: readonly DirectedPair[]): Map<string, number> {\n  const order = topologicalOrder(ids, pairs)\n  const { into } = adjacency(ids, pairs)\n  const layer = new Map<string, number>()\n  for (const id of order) {\n    let best = 0\n    for (const parent of into.get(id)!) {\n      const l = layer.get(parent)\n      if (l !== undefined) best = Math.max(best, l + 1)\n    }\n    layer.set(id, best)\n  }\n  return layer\n}\n\nexport type HopDirection = 'backward' | 'forward' | 'both'\n\n/**\n * Ids reachable from `focus` within `hops` steps. `backward` follows pairs\n * against their direction (towards what the focus was derived from),\n * `forward` along them. Returns a map id → distance (focus is 0).\n */\nexport function withinHops(focus: string, pairs: readonly DirectedPair[], hops: number, direction: HopDirection): Map<string, number> {\n  const forward = new Map<string, string[]>()\n  const backward = new Map<string, string[]>()\n  for (const { source, target } of pairs) {\n    if (!forward.has(source)) forward.set(source, [])\n    if (!backward.has(target)) backward.set(target, [])\n    forward.get(source)!.push(target)\n    backward.get(target)!.push(source)\n  }\n  const found = new Map<string, number>([[focus, 0]])\n  const walk = (links: Map<string, string[]>) => {\n    let frontier = [focus]\n    for (let step = 1; step <= hops && frontier.length; step++) {\n      const next: string[] = []\n      for (const id of frontier) {\n        for (const n of links.get(id) ?? Hosts pass their own. */\nexport const DEFAULT_TIER_THRESHOLDS: readonly [number, number, number] = [25, 50, 75]\n\n/** Maps a rating to one of four ordered tiers; a missing rating counts as the lowest. */\nexport function agentTier(rating?: number | null, thresholds: readonly [number, number, number] = DEFAULT_TIER_THRESHOLDS): AgentTier {\n  if (rating === undefined || rating === null || Number.isNaN(rating)) return 'beginner'\n  const [a, b, c] = thresholds\n  if (rating < a) return 'beginner'\n  if (rating < b) return 'intermediate'\n  if (rating < c) return 'advanced'\n  return 'expert'\n}\n\n/** FNV-1a over UTF-16 code units: small, stable, no dependency. */\nexport function nameHash(name: string): number {\n  let h = 0x811c9dc5\n  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {\n    h ^= name.charCodeAt(i)\n    h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0\n  }\n  return h >>> 0\n}\n\n/**\n * Deterministic geometric mark: a 5 × 5 grid mirrored left to right, cells\n * switched on by bits of the name hash. Same name, same picture; no faces.\n */\nexport function GeneratedAgentMark({ name }: { name: string }) {\n  const h = nameHash(name)\n  const cells: Array<[number, number]> = []\n  for (let row = 0; row < 5; row++) {\n    for (let col = 0; col < 3; col++) {\n      if ((h >>> (row * 3 + col)) & 1) {\n        cells.push([col, row])\n        if (col < 2) cells.push([4 - col, row])\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  const tone = (h % 8) + 1\n  return (\n    <svg className=\"ty-agent-mark__generated\" viewBox=\"0 0 5 5\" data-tone={`categorical-${tone}`} data-hash={h.toString(16)} aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\">\n      {cells.map(([x, y]) => (\n        <rect key={`${x}-${y}`} x={x} y={y} width={1} height={1} />\n      ))}\n    </svg>\n  )\n}\n\nexport interface AgentMarkProps {\n  name: string\n  image?: string | null\n  size?: 'sm' | 'md'\n  /** 'bot': the bot glyph without an image; 'generated': the name's geometric mark. */\n  fallback?: 'bot' | 'generated'\n}\n\n/** The square, dashed mark of an agent. ''].join(' ')\n}\n\n/** Tree rows for the list alternative: the focus as root (or the origins without focus), children follow links. */\nexport interface ProvTreeRow {\n  /** Unique path key (a DAG item may appear under several parents). */\n  key: string\n  id: string\n  /** Relation to the parent row, read from the parent: \"back\" (came from) or \"ahead\" (made from it). */\n  via?: { relation: ProvRelation; way: 'back' | 'ahead' }\n  children: ProvTreeRow[]\n}\n\nexport function provenanceTree(view: ProvView, focusId: string | null, direction: HopDirection): ProvTreeRow[] {\n  const ids = new Set(view.vertices.map((v) => v.id))\n  const build = (id: string, path: string, seen: Set<string>, via?: ProvTreeRow['via']): ProvTreeRow => {\n    const next = new Set(seen).add(id)\n    const children: ProvTreeRow[] = []\n    const { back, ahead } = relationsOf(id, view.links)\n    const wantBack = focusId !== null && direction !== 'forward'\n    const wantAhead = focusId === null || direction !== 'backward'\n    if (wantBack && (via?.way ?? 'back') === 'back') {\n      for (const l of back) if (!next.has(l.source)) children.push(build(l.source, `${path}/${l.source}`, next, { relation: l.relation, way: 'back' }))\n    }\n    if (wantAhead && (via?.way ?? 'ahead') === 'ahead') {\n      for (const l of ahead) if (!next.has(l.target)) children.push(build(l.target, `${path}/${l.target}`, next, { relation: l.relation, way: 'ahead' }))\n    }\n    return { key: path, id, ...(via ? { via } : {}), children }\n  }\n  if (focusId && ids.has(focusId)) return [build(focusId, focusId, new Set())]\n  const roots = view.vertices.filter((v) => !view.links.some((l) => l.target === v.id))\n  return roots.map((r) => build(r.id, r.id, new Set()))\n}\n\n/** Every row key of the tree (to expand all). */\nexport function treeKeys(rows: readonly ProvTreeRow[]): string[] {\n  return rows.flatMap((r) => [r.key, ...treeKeys(r.children)])\n}\n","// Strings of the provenance viewer. Output is React elements only: no HTML string is ever\n// injected, and links are kept only for http(s), mailto and app-relative paths.\n\nimport { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react'\n\ntype Block =\n  | { kind: 'heading'; level: number; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'paragraph'; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'list'; ordered: boolean; items: string[] }\n  | { kind: 'code'; lang: string; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'quote'; text: string }\n\nconst SAFE_HREF = /^(https?:\\/\\/|mailto:|\\/(?!\\/))/i\n\n/** Splits Markdown into blocks, line by line. */\nexport function markdownBlocks(source: string): Block[] {\n  const lines = source.replace(/\\r\\n?/g, '\\n').split('\\n')\n  const blocks: Block[] = []\n  let para: string[] = []\n  const flush = () => {\n    if (para.length) blocks.push({ kind: 'paragraph', text: para.join(' ') })\n    para = []\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {\n    const line = lines[i]!\n    const fence = /^\\s*```(\\w*)\\s*$/.exec(line)\n    if (fence) {\n      flush()\n      const body: string[] = []\n      i++\n      while (i < lines.length && !/^\\s*```\\s*$/.test(lines[i]!)) body.push(lines[i++]!)\n      blocks.push({ kind: 'code', lang: fence[1] ?? Days are calendar days in a time zone (the device's unless\n// one is given), so \"yesterday\" changes at local midnight.\n\nexport type DayBucket = 'today' | 'yesterday' | 'lastWeek' | 'older'\n\nconst MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000\n\n/** Whole days since the epoch of the calendar date `instant` falls on in `zone`. */\nexport function dayNumber(instant: Date, zone?: string): number {\n  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: zone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(instant)\n  const pick = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value ?? An unreadable date counts as older; empty\n * buckets are left out; the given order is kept inside a bucket.\n */\nexport function groupThreadsByDay<T extends { updatedAt: string | number | Date }>(threads: readonly T[], now: Date = new Date(), zone?: string): Array<{ bucket: DayBucket; threads: T[] }> {\n  const today = dayNumber(now, zone)\n  const found = new Map<DayBucket, T[]>()\n  for (const t of threads) {\n    const when = new Date(t.updatedAt)\n    const bucket = Number.isNaN(when.getTime()) ? interface ViewQuery {\n  focusId: string | null\n  /** Steps towards origins (\"where it came from\"). */\n  back: number\n  /** Steps towards uses (\"where it was used\"). */\n  forward: number\n Set()\n  } else {\n    visible = allowed\n  }\n\n  const links = kept.filter((l) => visible.has(l.source) && visible.has(l.target))\n  const vertices: ProvVertex[] = items.filter((i) => visible.has(i.id)).map((item) => ({ type: 'item', id: item.id, item }))\n\n  if (q.filters.actorsAsNodes) {\n    const actorById = new Map(actors.filter((a): a is ProvActor & { id: string } => vertices.map((v) => v.id)\n  const layer = layerIndex(ids, links)\n  const order = topologicalOrder(ids, links)\n  const rankOf = new Map(order.map((id, i) => [id, i]))\n  vertices.sort((a, b) => (layer.get(a.id)! - layer.get(b.id)!) || rankOf.get(a.id)! - rankOf.get(b.id)!)\n  return { vertices, links, distance, layer, focusFiltered, focusIsolated }\n}\n\n/** Direct neighbours of a vertex in ...EMPTY_FILTERS } })\n  return view.vertices.flatMap((v) => (v.type === 'item' ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>) : {}\n  }\n  /** First present value among the spellings. */\n  get(...spellings: string[]): unknown {\n    const hit = spellings.find((s) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.bag, s))\n    return hit === undefined ? undefined : this.bag[hit]\n  }\n  has(name: string): boolean {\n    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.bag, name)\n  }\n}\n\nconst KIND_ALIASES: Record<string, TraceSpan['kind']> = { ref: 'ref', reference: 'ref', value: 'value', literal: 'value' }\n\nfunction toSpan(raw: unknown): TraceSpan {\n  const w = new Wire(raw)\n  const span: TraceSpan = { kind: KIND_ALIASES[String(w.get('kind', 'span_kind') ?? '') }\n  const args = w.get('args', 'arguments')\n  if (args !== null && typeof args === 'object' && !Array.isArray(args)) span.args = args as Record<string, unknown>\n  if (w.has('result')) span.result = w.get('result')\n  const kids = w.get('children', 'child_spans')\n  if (Array.isArray(kids) && kids.length > 0) span.children = kids.map(toSpan)\n  return span\n}\n\n/** Maps a report whose keys may be snake case (frame_count …) onto TraceReport. */\nexport function traceReportFromWire(raw: unknown): TraceReport {\n  const w = new Wire(raw)\n  const count = (...names: string[]) => Number(w.get(...names) ?? Output is React elements only: no HTML string is ever\n// injected, and links are kept only for http(s), mailto and app-relative paths.\n\nimport { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react'\n\ntype Block =\n  | { kind: 'heading'; level: number; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'paragraph'; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'list'; ordered: boolean; items: string[] }\n  | { kind: 'code'; lang: string; text: string }\n  | { kind: 'quote'; text: string }\n\nconst SAFE_HREF = /^(https?:\\/\\/|mailto:|\\/(?!\\/))/i\n\n/** Splits Markdown into blocks, line by line. */\nexport function markdownBlocks(source: string): Block[] {\n  const lines = source.replace(/\\r\\n?/g, '\\n').split('\\n')\n  const blocks: Block[] = []\n  let para: string[] = []\n  const flush = () => {\n    if (para.length) blocks.push({ kind: 'paragraph', text: para.join(' ') })\n    para = []\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {\n    const line = lines[i]!\n    const fence = /^\\s*```(\\w*)\\s*$/.exec(line)\n    if (fence) {\n      flush()\n      const body: string[] = []\n      i++\n      while (i < lines.length && !/^\\s*```\\s*$/.test(lines[i]!)) body.push(lines[i++]!)\n      blocks.push({ kind: 'code', lang: fence[1] ?? defaultAgentEditorDialogLabels = agentEditorDialogLabels.bundles.en\n\n/** Even split of a 0–100 scale when the host gives no tiers (the product sets the real bands). */\nexport const DEFAULT_CAPABILITY_TIERS: readonly CapabilityTier[] = [\n  { key: 'basic', min: 0, max: 33, temperature: 0.3 },\n  { key: 'capable', min: 34, max: 66, temperature: 0.7 },\n  { key: 'advanced', min: },\n  { key: 'full', rating: 88 },\n]\n\n/** The most capable model whose rating does not exceed `rating` (else the least capable). */\nexport function modelForRating(models: readonly AgentModel[], rating: number): AgentModel | undefined {\n  const sorted = [...models].sort((a, b) => a.capability - b.capability)\n  let pick = sorted[0]\n  for (const m of sorted) if (m.capability <= rating) pick = m\n  return pick\n}\n\nexport function tierForRating(tiers: readonly CapabilityTier[], rating: number): CapabilityTier | undefined {\n  return tiers.find((t) => rating >= t.min && rating <= t.max) ?? (rating < (tiers[0]?.min ?? 0) ? tiers[0] : tiers[tiers.length - 1])\n}\n\ntype SaveStatus = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'failed'\n\nexport interface AgentEditorDialogProps {\n  onPersist?: (payload: AgentPayload) => Promise<void>\n  /** Legacy hook after an explicit save; autosave never calls it. */\n  onSaved?: () => void\n  models: AgentModel[]\n  providers: AgentProvider[]\n  credentialsHref: string\n  tiers?: readonly CapabilityTier[]\n  autonomyLevels?: readonly AutonomyLevel[]\n  /** Idle time before an edit is saved (ms). */\n  saveDelay?: number\n  labels?: Partial<AgentEditorDialogLabels>\n}\n\ninterface FormState {\n  id?: string\n  name: string\n  description: string\n  active: boolean\n  tags: string[]\n  image: string\n  rating: number\n  modelId: string\n  temperature: number\n  reasoningEffort: ReasoningEffort\n  maxOutput: string\n  topP: string\n  topK: string\n  systemPrompt: string\n  outputSchema?: Record<string, unknown>\n  toolServers: ToolServerEntry[]\n}\n\nfunction hydrate(agent: AgentEditorPayload['agent'], models: readonly AgentModel[], tiers: readonly CapabilityTier[]): FormState {\n  const a = (agent ?? {}) as Partial<AgentPayload> & { id?: string }\n  const model = models.find((m) => m.id === a.model) ?? modelForRating(models, tiers[0]?.min ?? 0)\n  const rating = model?.capability ?? tiers[0]?.min ?? 0\n  const num = (v: number | undefined) => (typeof v === 'number' ? String(v) : '')\n  return {\n    ...(a.id ? { id: a.id } : {}),\n    name: a.name ?? '',\n    description: a.description ?? '',\n    active: a.active ?? true,\n    tags: a.tags ?? [],\n    image: a.image ?? '',\n    rating,\n    modelId: model?.id ?? '',\n    temperature: a.temperature ?? tierForRating(tiers, rating)?.temperature ?? 0.7,\n    reasoningEffort: a.reasoningEffort ?? 'medium',\n    maxOutput: num(a.maxOutputTokens),\n    topP: num(a.topP),\n    topK: num(a.topK),\n    systemPrompt: a.systemPrompt ?? '',\n    ...(a.outputSchema ? { outputSchema: a.outputSchema } : {}),\n    toolServers: a.toolServers ?? [],\n  }\n}\n\nexport function AgentEditorDialog(props: AgentEditorDialogProps) {\n  const { onPersist, models, providers, credentialsHref, tiers = DEFAULT_CAPABILITY_TIERS, autonomyLevels = DEFAULT_AUTONOMY_LEVELS, saveDelay = 1200 } = props\n  const l = useLabels(agentEditorDialogLabels, props.labels)\n  const { locale, direction } = useFlowLocale()\n  const active = useActiveDialog<AgentEditorPayload>('agent-editor')\n  const stack = useDialogStack()\n  const confirm = useConfirm()\n\n  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState | null>(null)\n  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'create' | 'edit'>('edit')\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SaveStatus>('idle')\n  const [section, setSection] = useState('engine')\n  const formRef = useRef<FormState | null>(null)\n  formRef.current = form\n  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)\n  const inFlight = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null)\n  const again = useRef(false)\n\n  // Hydrate on open; never counts as an edit.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!active) {\n      setForm(null)\n      return\n    }\n    setForm(hydrate(active.payload.agent, models, tiers))\n    setMode(active.payload.mode)\n    setStatus('idle')\n    setSection('engine')\n    // Only a new opening re-hydrates.\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [active])\n\n  useEffect(() => () => {\n    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current)\n  }, [])\n\n  const model = form ? models.find((m) => m.id === form.modelId) : undefined\n  const provider = model ? providers.find((p) => p.families.includes(model.family)) : undefined\n\n  const payloadOf = useCallback(\n    (f: FormState): AgentPayload => {\n      const m = models.find((x) => x.id === f.modelId)\n      const p = m ? providers.find((x) => x.families.includes(m.family)) : undefined\n      const numOrUndef = (s: string) => (s.trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(s)) ? Number(s) : undefined)\n      const out: AgentPayload = { name: f.name.trim(), active: f.active, tags: f.tags }\n      if (f.id) out.id = f.id\n      if (f.description.trim()) out.description = f.description.trim()\n      if (f.image.trim()) out.image = f.image.trim()\n      if (m) out.model = m.id\n      if (p) out.provider = p.id\n      if (m?.reasoning) out.reasoningEffort = f.reasoningEffort\n      else out.temperature = f.temperature\n      const mo = numOrUndef(f.maxOutput)\n      const tp = numOrUndef(f.topP)\n      const tk = numOrUndef(f.topK)\n      if (mo !== undefined && m?.supports?.maxOutput) out.maxOutputTokens = mo\n      if (tp !== undefined && m?.supports?.topP) out.topP = tp\n      if (tk !== undefined && m?.supports?.topK) out.topK = tk\n      if (f.systemPrompt.trim()) out.systemPrompt = f.systemPrompt\n      if (f.outputSchema) out.outputSchema = f.outputSchema\n      const servers = cleanToolServers(f.toolServers) as ToolServerEntry[] | undefined\n      if (servers) out.toolServers = servers\n      return out\n    },\n    [models, providers],\n  )\n\n  const persistNow = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {\n    if (timer.current) {\n      clearTimeout(timer.current)\n      timer.current = null\n    }\n    const f = formRef.current\n    if (!f || !onPersist) return\n    if (inFlight.current) {\n      again.current = true\n      return inFlight.current\n    }\n    setStatus('saving')\n    const run = onPersist(payloadOf(f))\n      .then(() => {\n        setStatus('saved')\n        setMode('edit')\n      })\n      .catch(() => setStatus('failed'))\n      .finally(() => {\n        inFlight.current = null\n        if (again.current) {\n          again.current = false\n          void persistNow()\n        }\n      })\n    inFlight.current = run\n    return run\n  }, [onPersist, payloadOf])\n\n  const edit = (patch: Partial<FormState>) => {\n    setForm((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, ...patch } : prev))\n    setStatus('pending')\n    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current)\n    timer.current = setTimeout(() => void persistNow(), saveDelay)\n  }\n\n  const close = async () => {\n    if (status === 'failed') {\n      const ok = await confirm({ title: l.confirmCloseTitle, message: l.confirmCloseMessage, confirmLabel: l.confirmClose, cancelLabel: l.keepEditing, tone: 'danger' })\n      if (!ok) return\n    } else if (timer.current || inFlight.current) {\n      await persistNow()\n    }\n    stack.close()\n  }\n\n  const tier = form ? tierForRating(tiers, form.rating) : undefined\n  const tierName = tier ? (l.tierNames[tier.key] ?? tier.key) : ''\n  const nf = useMemo(() => new Intl.NumberFormat(locale), [locale])\n  const capabilityRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)\n  const temperatureRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)\n  const temperatureRange = form ? (form.temperature < 0.4 ? l.temperatureRanges.precise : form.temperature < 1 ? l.temperatureRanges.balanced : l.temperatureRanges.creative) : ''\n  useValueText(capabilityRef, form ? `${nf.format(form.rating)}, ${tierName}` : '')\n  useValueText(temperatureRef, form ? `${nf.format(form.temperature)}, ${temperatureRange}` : '')\n  const statusId = useId()\n\n  if (!active || !form) return null\n\n  const bandOf = (level: AutonomyLevel) => {\n    const idx = autonomyLevels.indexOf(level)\n    const next = autonomyLevels[idx + 1]\n    return form.rating >= level.rating - (idx === 0 ? Infinity : 0) && (!next || form.rating < next.rating)\n  }\n  const currentAutonomy = autonomyLevels.find(bandOf)?.key ?? null\n\n  const setRating = (rating: number) => {\n    const m = modelForRating(models, rating)\n    const t = tierForRating(tiers, rating)\n    edit({ rating, modelId: m?.id ?? form.modelId, ...(t?.temperature !== undefined ? { temperature: t.temperature } : {}) })\n  }\n\n  const statusView = (\n    <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__status\" data-status={status}>\n      <p id={statusId} role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" className=\"ty-agent-editor__status-line\">\n        {status === 'saving' ? (\n          <>\n            <Loader aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" className=\"ty-agent-editor__spin\" />\n            {l.statusSaving}\n          </>\n        ) : status === 'pending' ? (\n          <>\n            <Clock aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" />\n            {l.statusPending}\n          </>\n        ) : status === 'saved' ? (\n          <>\n            <CircleCheck aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" />\n            {l.statusSaved}\n          </>\n        ) : status === 'failed' ? (\n          <>\n            <CircleAlert aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" />\n            {l.statusFailed}\n          </>\n        ) : null}\n      </p>\n      {status === 'failed' ? (\n        <Button size=\"compact\" variant=\"secondary\" onPress={() => void persistNow()}>\n          {l.retry}\n        </Button>\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  )\n\n  const identity = (\n    <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__identity\">\n      <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__identity-head\">\n        <AgentMark image={form.image} size=\"lg\" />\n        <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__name-block\">\n          <AriaTextField className=\"ty-agent-editor__name\" value={form.name} onChange={(name) => edit({ name })}>\n            <Label className=\"ty-visually-hidden\">{l.name}</Label>\n            <Input className=\"ty-agent-editor__name-input\" placeholder={l.namePlaceholder} />\n          </AriaTextField>\n          <span className=\"ty-agent-editor__kind-word\">{l.agentWord}</span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <Switch label={l.active} isSelected={form.active} onChange={(v) => edit({ active: v })} />\n      <TextField label={l.image} inputType=\"url\" value={form.image} onChange={(image) => edit({ image })} />\n      <TextArea label={l.description} value={form.description} onChange={(description) => edit({ description })} rows={2} />\n      <TagInput label={l.tags} value={form.tags} onChange={(tags) => edit({ tags })} removeLabel={l.removeTag} />\n    </div>\n  )\n\n  const engine = (\n    <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__section\">\n      <Slider className=\"ty-agent-slider\" minValue={0} maxValue={100} step={1} value={form.rating} onChange={(v) => setRating(Array.isArray(v) ? [currentAutonomy] : []}\n          onSelectionChange={(keys) => {\n            const key = [...keys][0]\n            const level = autonomyLevels.find((a) => a.key === key)\n            if (level) setRating(level.rating)\n          }}\n        >\n          {autonomyLevels.map((a) => (\n            <ToggleButton key={a.key} id={a.key} className=\"ty-agent-autonomy__level\">\n              {l.autonomyNames[a.key]}\n            </ToggleButton>\n          ))}\n        </ToggleButtonGroup>\n      </div>\n      <dl className=\"ty-agent-editor__summary\">\n        <div>\n          <dt>{l.model}</dt>\n          <dd className=\"ty-agent-editor__mono\">{model ? (model.name ?? model.id) : ''}</dd>\n          {model?.contextSize ? <dd className=\"ty-agent-editor__meta\">{fill(l.contextSize, { size: model.contextSize }, locale)}</dd> : null}\n          {model?.outputLimit ? <dd className=\"ty-agent-editor__meta\">{fill(l.outputLimit, { size: model.outputLimit }, locale)}</dd> : null}\n        </div>\n      </dl>\n      {model && provider ? (\n        <p className=\"ty-agent-editor__served\" data-configured={provider.configured}>\n          {fill(l.servedVia, { provider: provider.name })}\n          <span className=\"ty-agent-editor__provider-state\">\n            {provider.configured ? <CircleCheck aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" /> : <CircleAlert aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" />}\n            {provider.configured ? l.connected : l.needsSetup}\n          </span>\n        </p>\n      ) : model ? (\n        <InlineNotice tone=\"warning\" urgency=\"none\">\n          {l.noProvider}\n        </InlineNotice>\n      ) : null}\n      <Disclosure className=\"ty-agent-editor__advanced\">\n        <Heading level={3} className=\"ty-agent-editor__advanced-heading\">\n          <AriaButton slot=\"trigger\" className=\"ty-agent-editor__advanced-trigger\">\n            <ChevronDown aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" className=\"ty-agent-editor__chevron\" />\n            {l.advanced}\n          </AriaButton>\n        </Heading>\n        <DisclosurePanel className=\"ty-agent-editor__advanced-panel\">\n          <NativeSelect\n            label={l.manualModel}\n            value={form.modelId}\n            options={models.map((m) => ({ value: m.id, label: m.name ?? <CircleCheck aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" /> : <CircleAlert aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\" />}\n                    {p.configured ? l.connected : l.needsSetup}\n                  </span>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n            <Link href={credentialsHref}>{l.manageCredentials}</Link>\n          </div>\n        </DisclosurePanel>\n      </Disclosure>\n    </div>\n  )\n\n  const effortKeys: ReasoningEffort[] = ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'very_high']\n  const instructions = (\n    <div className=\"ty-agent-editor__section\">\n      {model?.reasoning ? Days are calendar days in a time zone (the device's unless\n// one is given), so \"yesterday\" changes at local midnight.\n\nexport type DayBucket = 'today' | 'yesterday' | 'lastWeek' | 'older'\n\nconst MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000\n\n/** Whole days since the epoch of the calendar date `instant` falls on in `zone`. */\nexport function dayNumber(instant: Date, zone?: string): number {\n  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: zone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(instant)\n  const pick = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value ?? NaN)\n  return Math.floor(Date.UTC(pick('year'), pick('month') - 1, pick('day')) / MS_PER_DAY)\n}\n\n/** Upper age limit (in days) of each bucket, in display order. */\nconst LIMITS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [DayBucket, number]> = [\n  ['today', 0],\n  ['yesterday', 1],\n  ['lastWeek', 7],\n  ['older', Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],\n]\n\nfunction bucketFor(age: number): DayBucket {\n  for (const [bucket, limit] of LIMITS) if (age <= limit) return bucket\n  return 'older'\n}\n\n/**\n * Groups threads by day bucket. An unreadable date counts as older; empty\n * buckets are left out; the given order is kept inside a bucket.\n */\nexport function groupThreadsByDay<T extends { updatedAt: string | number | Date }>(threads: readonly T[], now: Date = new Date(), zone?: string): Array<{ bucket: DayBucket; threads: T[] }> {\n  const today = dayNumber(now, zone)\n  const found = new Map<DayBucket, T[]>()\n  for (const t of threads) {\n    const when = new Date(t.updatedAt)\n    const bucket = Number.isNaN(when.getTime()) ? 'older' : bucketFor(today - dayNumber(when, zone))\n    const list = found.get(bucket) ?? []\n    list.push(t)\n    found.set(bucket, list)\n  }\n  return LIMITS.flatMap(([bucket]) => (found.has(bucket) ? [{ bucket, threads: found.get(bucket)! }] : []))\n}\n","// Past threads, as a navigation landmark: a start button, a \"starred only\"\n// toggle, then shelves of threads by calendar day. Other scripts' marks (Indic vowel signs,\n// Thai tone marks…) carry meaning and are kept.\nconst OPTIONAL_MARK = /[\\u0300-\\u036f\\u0591-\\u05c7\\u064b-\\u065f\\u0670\\u06d6-\\u06ed]/gu\n\nfunction segmenter(granularity: 'grapheme' | 'word', locale?: string) {\n  const Seg = (Intl as { Segmenter?: typeof Intl.Segmenter }).Segmenter\n  return Seg ? new Seg(locale, { granularity }) : null\n}\n\n/** Folds one grapheme: compatibility-normalised, optional diacritics dropped, locale-lowercased. */\nfunction foldUnit(grapheme: string, locale?: string): string {\n  const bare = grapheme.normalize('NFKD').replace(OPTIONAL_MARK, '')\n  return (bare || grapheme).normalize('NFC').toLocaleLowerCase(locale)\n}\n\n/** Splits text into grapheme units, marking the ones that start a word (any script). */\nfunction unitsOf(text: string, locale?: string): Unit[] {\n  const starts = new Set<number>([0])\n  const words = segmenter('word', locale)\n  if (words) {\n    for (const w of words.segment(text)) if (w.isWordLike) starts.add(w.index)\n  } else {\n    for (const m of text.matchAll(/(?<=[\\s\\p{P}])\\S/gu)) starts.add(m.index)\n  }\n  const graphemes = segmenter('grapheme', locale)\n  const pieces = graphemes ? [...graphemes.segment(text)].map((g) => ({ segment: g.segment, index: g.index })) : [...text].reduce<Array<{ segment: string; index: number }>>((acc, ch) => {\n    const prev = acc[acc.length - 1]\n    acc.push({ segment: ch, index: prev ? prev.index + prev.segment.length : 0 })\n    return acc\n  }, [])\n  return pieces\n    .map((g) => ({ key: foldUnit(g.segment, locale), from: g.index, to: g.index + g.segment.length, wordStart: starts.has(g.index) }))\n}\n\n/** UTF-16 indices covered by the matched units (what markPieces expects). */\nconst covered = (units: Unit[], picked: number[]) => picked.flatMap((k) => Array.from({ length: units[k]!.to - units[k]!.from }, (_, j) => units[k]!.from + j))\n\n/**\n * In-order match of the query's characters in the text, grapheme by\n * grapheme, for any script. `locale` drives lower-casing and word breaks\n * (so CJK and Thai get real word starts).\n */\nexport function fuzzyHit(query: string, text: string, locale?: string): FuzzyHit | null {\n  const q = unitsOf(query.trim(), locale).map((u) => u.key)\n  if (!q.length) return { score: 0, at: [] }\n  const t = unitsOf(text, locale)\n  const keys = t.map((u) => u.key)\n  // Contiguous run first.\n  for (let i = 0; i + q.length <= keys.length; i++) {\n    if (q.every((k, j) => keys[i + j] === k)) {\n      const picked = q.map((_, j) => i + j)\n      return { score: 1000 + q.length * 12 + (t[i]!.wordStart ? 60 : 0) - i, at: covered(t, picked) }\n    }\n  }\n  const picked: number[] = []\n  let cursor = 0\n  for (const k of q) {\n    let pick = -1\n    for (let i = cursor; i < keys.length; i++) {\n      if (keys[i] !== k) continue\n      if (pick < 0) pick = i\n      if (t[i]!.wordStart) {\n        pick = i\n        break\n      }\n    }\n    if (pick < 0) return null\n    picked.push(pick)\n    cursor = pick + 1\n  }\n  let score = 0\n  picked.forEach((pos, k) => {\n    const prev = picked[k - 1]\n    score += 4\n    if (prev !== undefined && pos === prev + 1) score += 10\n    if (t[pos]!.wordStart) score += 8\n  })\n  return { score: score - (picked[0] ?? 0), at: covered(t, picked) }\n}\n\n/** Splits `text` into plain and marked pieces from matched indices. */\nexport function markPieces(text: string, at: readonly number[]): Array<{ text: string; marked: boolean }> {\n  const hits = new Set(at)\n  const out: Array<{ text: string; marked: boolean }> = []\n  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {\n    const marked = hits.has(i)\n    const last = out[out.length - 1]\n    if (last && last.marked === marked) last.text += text[i]\n    else out.push({ text: text[i] ?? '', marked })\n  }\n  return out\n}\n","// Remembered choices of the CommandPalette.\n//\n// Persisted under a host key as one JSON object: { [id]: [timesChosen, lastChosenAt] }.\n// Storage may be missing, blocked or full; every access is guarded and a\n// broken store simply reads as empty.\n\nexport interface ChoiceStat {\n  id: string\n  /** How many times it was chosen. */\n  count: number\n  /** When it was last chosen (epoch ms). */\n  at: number\n}\n\ntype Ledger = Record<string, [number, number]>\n\nfunction box(): Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'> | undefined {\n  try {\n    return typeof window === 'undefined' ? undefined : window.localStorage\n  } catch {\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\nfunction readLedger(key: string): Ledger {\n  let text: string | null | undefined\n  try {\n    text = box()?.getItem(key)\n  } catch {\n    return {}\n  }\n  if (!text) return {}\n  try {\n    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(text)\n    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return {}\n    const clean: Ledger = {}\n    for (const [id, pair] of Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)) {\n      if (Array.isArray(pair) && typeof pair[0] === 'number' && typeof pair[1] === 'number') clean[id] = [pair[0], pair[1]]\n    }\n    return clean\n  } catch {\n    return {}\n  }\n}\n\nconst toStats = (ledger: Ledger): ChoiceStat[] => Object.entries(ledger).map(([id, [count, at]]) => ({ id, count, at }))\n\n/** Everything remembered under `key`. */\nexport function readChoices(key: string): ChoiceStat[] {\n  return toStats(readLedger(key))\n}\n\n/** Most chosen first; ties go to the most recent. */\nexport function orderChoices(stats: readonly ChoiceStat[]): ChoiceStat[] {\n  return stats.slice().sort((x, y) => (x.count === y.count ? y.at - x.at : y.count - x.count))\n}\n\n/** Counts one more choice of `id`, keeps the `limit` most recent ids, returns the result. */\nexport function recordChoice(key: string, id: string, limit = 12, when = Date.now()): ChoiceStat[] {\n  const ledger = readLedger(key)\n  const [times] = ledger[id] ?? The\n// same function draws the home page's hero plate and the Tympan mark, so they stay in sync.\n\nexport interface PlateCircle {\n  cy: number\n  r: number\n}\n\nexport interface PlateGeometry {\n  /** Centre and radius of the plate rim. */\n  c: number\n  r: number\n  /** Radius of the equator circle. */\n  equator: number\n  /** Almucantar of altitude `deg` (0 = horizon). */\n  almucantar: (deg: number) => PlateCircle\n  /** y of the zenith. */\n  zenith: number\n  /** Tick marks on the outer ring every `stepDeg`, `long` every `longEvery` ticks. */\n  ticks: (stepDeg: number, longEvery?: number, ring?: number) => Array<{ x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number; long: boolean }>\n}\n\nexport function plateGeometry(latitudeDeg = -23.53, c = 200, r = 180): PlateGeometry {\n  const phi = (latitudeDeg * Math.PI) / 180\n  const k = r * Math.tan(Math.PI / 4 - (23.44 * Math.PI) / 180 / 2)\n  const almucantar = (deg: number): PlateCircle => {\n    const h = (deg * Math.PI) / 180\n    const lat = Math.abs(phi)\n    const y1 = k * Math.tan((Math.PI / 2 - (lat + (Math.PI / 2 - h))) / 2)\n    const y2 = k * Math.tan((Math.PI / 2 - (lat - (Math.PI / 2 - h))) / 2)\n    return { cy: c + (-y2 - y1) / 2, r: Math.abs(y1 - y2) / 2 }\n  }\n  const ticks = (stepDeg: number, longEvery = 6, ring = 12) =>\n    Array.from({ length: Math.round(360 / stepDeg) }, (_, i) => {\n      const a = (i * stepDeg * Math.PI) / 180\n      const long = i % longEvery === 0\n      const l = long ? A value\n * belongs to class k when it is ≥ break k−1 and < break k (the last class\n * is open). Repeated breaks are kept, so the class count never changes.\n */\nexport function quantis(valores: number[], n: number): number[] {\n  const v = valores.filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x)).sort((a, b) => a - b)\n  if (!v.length || n < 2) return []\n  const out: number[] = []\n  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {\n    // Type 7 (linear interpolation between order statistics).\n    const h = (v.length - 1) * (i / n)\n    const lo = Math.floor(h)\n    const a = v[lo] as number\n    const b = v[Math.min(lo + 1, v.length - 1)] as number\n    out.push(a + (h - lo) * (b - a))\n  }\n  return out\n}\n\n/** Class of a value against ascending breaks (0 … breaks.length). */\nexport function classeDe(valor: number, limites: number[]): number {\n  let k = 0\n  while (k < limites.length && valor >= (limites[k] as number)) k++\n  return k\n}\n\n/** Legend labels for breaks: \"menos de a\", \"a a menos de b\", …, \"b ou mais\". */\nexport function rotulosLimites(limites: number[], unidade = ''): string[] {\n  const u = unidade ? ` ${unidade}` : ''\n  const f = (x: number) => formatarNumero(Math.round(x * 100) / 100)\n  if (!limites.length) return ['todos']\n  const out = [`menos de ${f(limites[0] as number)}${u}`]\n  for (let i = 1; i < limites.length; i++) out.push(`${f(limites[i - 1] as number)} a menos de ${f(limites[i] as number)}${u}`)\n  out.push(`${f(limites[limites.length - 1] as number)}${u} ou mais`)\n  return out\n}\n","","","// Brazil's meshes (IBGE Malha Municipal 2022, simplified by\n// scripts/gerar-malhas.mjs) and the projection. 'var(--ty-print-tinta)' : lado < 0 ? 'var(--ty-print-destaque-2)' : 'var(--ty-print-destaque)')\n  const papel = 'var(--ty-print-papel)'\n  const padroes: ReactNode[] = []\n  const fills: string[] = []\n  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {\n    const { t, lado } = posicao(k, n, escala)\n    const c = cor(lado)\n    if (modo === 'chapado') {\n      const pct = escala === 'divergente' ? 8 + (lado < 0 ? 62 : 84) * t : 14 + 86 * t\n      fills.push(`color-mix(in oklab, ${c} ${Math.round(pct)}%, ${papel})`)\n      continue\n    }\n    const pid = `${id}-k${k}`\n    fills.push(`url(#${pid})`)\n    if (modo === 'pontos') {\n      const e = 1.05\n      const r = r3(0.1 + 0.36 * t)\n      padroes.push(\n        <pattern key={pid} id={pid} width={e} height={e} patternUnits=\"userSpaceOnUse\" patternTransform=\"rotate(30)\">\n          <rect width={e} height={e} style={{ fill: papel }} />\n          <circle cx={e / 2} cy={e / 2} r={r} style={lado < 0 && pb ? { fill: 'none', stroke: c, strokeWidth: 0.12 } : { fill: c }} />\n        </pattern>,\n      )\n      continue\n    }\n    // Hatch: denser and heavier with the class; crossed on the upper classes;\n    // the last one solid. Diverging sides lean opposite ways (/ and \\).\n    if (t >= 0.999 && n >= 4 && escala === 'sequencial') {\n      padroes.push(\n        <pattern key={pid} id={pid} width={1} height={1} patternUnits=\"userSpaceOnUse\">\n          <rect width={1} height={1} style={{ fill: c }} />\n        </pattern>,\n      )\n      continue\n    }\n    // Ink coverage steps of about 6, 15, 30 and 55 % before solid, so\n    // neighbouring classes stay apart in black and white.\n    const degrau = t < 0.15 ? 0 : t < 0.4 ? 1 : t < 0.65 ? 2 : 3\n    const e = [1.6, 1.05, 0.8, 0.8][degrau] as number\n    const w = r3(([0.09, 0.16, 0.24, 0.26][degrau] as number) * (grossa ? 1.3 : 1))\n    const cruz = degrau === 3\n    const giro = lado < 0 ? -45 : 45\n    padroes.push(\n      <pattern key={pid} id={pid} width={e} height={e} patternUnits=\"userSpaceOnUse\" patternTransform={`rotate(${giro})`}>\n        <rect width={e} height={e} style={{ fill: papel }} />\n        {lado === 0 ? null : <line x1={0} y1={0} x2={0} y2={e} style={{ stroke: c, strokeWidth: w }} />}\n        {cruz ? <line x1={0} y1={e / 2} x2={e} y2={e / 2} style={{ stroke: c, strokeWidth: w }} /> : null}\n        {lado === 0 ? <circle cx={e / 2} cy={e / 2} r={0.12} style={{ fill: c }} /> : null}\n      </pattern>,\n    )\n  }\n  // \"No data\": fine horizontal dashes in the context grey, unlike any class.\n  const sd = `${id}-sd`\n  padroes.push(\n    <pattern key={sd} id={sd} width={1.2} height={0.7} patternUnits=\"userSpaceOnUse\">\n      <rect width={1.2} height={0.7} style={{ fill: papel }} />\n      <line x1={0.1} y1={0.35} x2={0.75} y2={0.35} style={{ stroke: 'var(--ty-print-contexto)', strokeWidth: 0.14 }} />\n    </pattern>,\n  )\n  return {\n    fill: (k) => (k === SEM_DADO ? `url(#${sd})` : k === SEM_SERIE ? papel : (fills[k] ?? papel)),\n    defs: padroes,\n  }\n}\n\nfunction modoDe(nome: RenderizadorGrafico, pb: boolean): Modo {\n  if (nome === 'pontos') return 'pontos'\n  if (pb || nome === 'gravura') return 'hachura'\n  return 'chapado'\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Component\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/** Areas grouped by class, classes in ascending order (no data first). */\nfunction porClasse(areas: AreaPosta[], ks: number[]): Array<[number, AreaPosta[]]> {\n  const m = new Map<number, AreaPosta[]>()\n  areas.forEach((a, i) => {\n    const k = ks[i] as number\n    const l = m.get(k)\n    if (l) l.push(a)\n    else m.set(k, [a])\n  })\n  return [...m.entries()].sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0])\n}\n\n/** One map drawn in a cell: its areas with classes, borders, labels and highlights. */\ninterface Celula {\n  chave: string\n  titulo?: string\n  g: Geometria\n  ks: number[]\n  alvo: AreaPosta[]\n  x: number\n  y: number\n}\n\n/**\n * Choropleth map of Brazil on the IBGE 2022 mesh (Albers equal-area conic,\n * parallels −2° and −22°, meridian −54°). With\n * `multiplos`, a grid of small maps with shared classes and one legend.\n */\nexport function Mapa({\n  titulo,\n  alt,\n  nivel = 'municipio',\n  valores,\n  classes,\n  limites,\n  unidade,\n  escala = 'sequencial',\n  destaques,\n  recorte,\n  exemplo = false,\n  legenda,\n  semDado = 'sem dado',\n  rotulos,\n  comoLer,\n  naoMostra,\n  tabela,\n  renderizador,\n  largura: larguraProp,\n  altura,\n  multiplos,\n  colunas,\n  sangria = false,\n  className,\n}: MapaProps) {\n  const { estilo, pb } = usePrint()\n  const disponivel = useLarguraDisponivel()\n  const id = useIdSeguro('ty-print-mapa')\n  const W = r3(larguraProp ?? disponivel ?? (sangria ? 150 : 110))\n  const nome = renderizador ?? estilo.grafico\n  const modo = modoDe(nome, pb)\n\n  // The maps: one, or a grid of small multiples.\n  const itens: Array<MapaMultiplo & { chave: string; unico: boolean }> = multiplos?.length\n    ? multiplos.map((m, i) => ({ ...m, recorte: m.recorte, exemplo: m.exemplo ?? exemplo, valores: m.valores ?? valores, classes: m.classes ?? classes, chave: `${i}|${m.titulo}`, unico: false }))\n    : [{ titulo, recorte, valores, classes, destaques, exemplo, chave: titulo, unico: true }]\n  const nCol = Math.max(1, Math.min(itens.length, colunas ?? 3))\n  const nLin = Math.ceil(itens.length / nCol)\n  const vao = itens.length > 1 ? 3 : 0\n  const cabecaCelula = itens.length > 1 ? 4.2 : 0\n  const Wc = r3((W - vao * (nCol - 1)) / nCol)\n  const Hc = altura ? (algumValor ? quantis(vals, legenda?.length ?? 5) : undefined)\n  const todasClasses = itens.flatMap((it) => (it.classes ? Math.min(n - 1, classeDe(v, lim ?? Pure functions, no randomness: the same\n// points always give the same coefficient, line, bins and ticks.\n\nconst r3 = (n: number) => {\n  const v = Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000\n  return Object.is(v, -0) ? 0 : v\n}\n\nexport function media(v: readonly number[]): number {\n  let s = 0\n  for (const a of v) s += a\n  return v.length ? s / v.length : NaN\n}\n\n/** Pearson's r; `null` with fewer than 3 points or no variance. */\nexport function pearson(x: readonly number[], y: readonly number[]): number | null {\n  const n = Math.min(x.length, y.length)\n  if (n < 3) return null\n  const mx = media(x.slice(0, n))\n  const my = media(y.slice(0, n))\n  let sxy = 0\n  let sxx = 0\n  let syy = 0\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    const dx = x[i]! - mx\n    const dy = y[i]! - my\n    sxy += dx * dy\n    sxx += dx * dx\n    syy += dy * dy\n  }\n  if (sxx === 0 || syy === 0) return null\n  return sxy / Math.sqrt(sxx * syy)\n}\n\n/** Mid-ranks (ties share the average rank), 1-based. */\nexport function postos(v: readonly number[]): number[] {\n  const ordem = v.map((_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => v[a]! - v[b]! || a - b)\n  const r = new Array<number>(v.length)\n  let i = 0\n  while (i < ordem.length) {\n    let j = i\n    while (j + 1 < ordem.length && v[ordem[j + 1]!] === v[ordem[i]!]) j++\n    for (let k = i; k <= j; k++) r[ordem[k]!] = (i + j) / 2 + 1\n    i = j + 1\n  }\n  return r\n}\n\n/** Spearman's ρ = Pearson on mid-ranks. */\nexport function spearman(x: readonly number[], y: readonly number[]): number | null {\n  return pearson(postos(x), postos(y))\n}\n\n/** Least squares y = a + b·x. */\nexport function minimosQuadrados(x: readonly number[], y: readonly number[]): { a: number; b: number } | null {\n  if (x.length < 2) return null\n  const mx = media(x)\n  const my = media(y)\n  let sxy = 0\n  let sxx = 0\n  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {\n    sxy += (x[i]! - mx) * (y[i]! - my)\n    sxx += (x[i]! - mx) ** 2\n  }\n  if (sxx === 0) return null\n  const b = sxy / sxx\n  return { a: my - b * mx, b }\n}\n\n/** Values minus their group mean (fixed effects by group). */\nexport function centrarPorGrupo(v: readonly number[], g: readonly string[]): number[] {\n  const soma = new Map<string, number>()\n  const cont = new Map<string, number>()\n  v.forEach((a, i) => {\n    soma.set(g[i]!, (soma.get(g[i]!) ?? 0) + a)\n    cont.set(g[i]!, (cont.get(g[i]!) ?? 0) + 1)\n  })\n  return v.map((a, i) => a - soma.get(g[i]!)! / cont.get(g[i]!)!)\n}\n\n/** Pooled within-group correlation: Pearson of the group-centred values. */\nexport function correlacaoDentro(x: readonly number[], y: readonly number[], g: readonly string[]): number | null {\n  return pearson(centrarPorGrupo(x, g), centrarPorGrupo(y, g))\n}\n\nexport function quantil(ordenado: readonly number[], q: number): number {\n  if (!ordenado.length) return NaN\n  const p = (ordenado.length - 1) * q\n  const i = Math.floor(p)\n  const f = p - i\n  return i + 1 < ordenado.length ? ordenado[i]! * (1 - f) + ordenado[i + 1]! * f : ordenado[i]!\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Scales (mm)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface EscalaEixo {\n  (v: number): number\n  log: boolean\n  dominio: [number, number]\n  faixa: [number, number]\n  /** Value in the space where the line and the coefficient are computed (ln for log axes). */\n  t: (v: number) => number\n  /** Position (mm) of a value already in that space. */\n  deT: (tv: number) => number\n  /** Domain bounds in that space. */\n  t0: number\n  t1: number\n}\n\nexport function escalaEixo(dominio: [number, number], faixa: [number, number], log = false): EscalaEixo {\n  const t = log ? (v: number) => Math.log(v) : (v: number) => v\n  const d0 = t(dominio[0])\n  const d1 = t(dominio[1])\n  const k = d1 === d0 ? 0 : (faixa[1] - faixa[0]) / (d1 - d0)\n  const f = ((v: number) => r3(faixa[0] + (t(v) - d0) * k)) as EscalaEixo\n  f.log = log\n  f.dominio = dominio\n  f.faixa = faixa\n  f.t = t\n  f.deT = (tv: number) => r3(faixa[0] + (tv - d0) * k)\n  f.t0 = d0\n  f.t1 = d1\n  return f\n}\n\n/** Domain padded to nice bounds around the data (linear) or to powers of ten (log). */\nexport function dominioAuto(valores: readonly number[], log = false): [number, number] {\n  const v = log ? valores.filter((a) => a > 0) : [...valores]\n  if (!v.length) return log ? [1, 10] : [0, 1]\n  let lo = Infinity\n  let hi = -Infinity\n  for (const a of v) {\n    if (a < lo) lo = a\n    if (a > hi) hi = a\n  }\n  if (log) return [10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(lo) + 1e-9), 10 ** Math.ceil(Math.log10(hi) - 1e-9)]\n  if (lo === hi) return [lo - 1, hi + 1]\n  const passo = passoBonito((hi - lo) / 5)\n  return [r3(Math.floor(lo / passo + 1e-9) * passo), r3(Math.ceil(hi / passo - 1e-9) * passo)]\n}\n\nfunction passoBonito(raw: number): number {\n  const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))\n  const norm = raw / mag\n  return (norm < 1.5 ? 1 : norm < 2.25 ? 2 : norm < 3.5 ? 2.5 : norm < 7.5 ? 5 : 10) * mag\n}\n\n/** Ticks for a log axis: 1-2-5 per decade when there are few decades, powers of ten otherwise. */\nexport function marcasLog([d0, d1]: [number, number]): number[] {\n  const e0 = Math.floor(Math.log10(d0) + 1e-9)\n  const e1 = Math.ceil(Math.log10(d1) - 1e-9)\n  const mult = e1 - e0 <= 2 ? [1, 2, 5] : e1 - e0 <= 4 ? [1, 3] : [1]\n  const out: number[] = []\n  for (let e = e0; e <= e1; e++)\n    for (const m of mult) {\n      const v = m * 10 ** e\n      if (v >= d0 * (1 - 1e-9) && v <= d1 * (1 + 1e-9)) out.push(Number(v.toPrecision(12)))\n    }\n  return out\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Number formats (pt-BR)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst MENOS = '−'\n\n/** A coefficient with explicit sign and 3 decimals: \"+0,056\", \"−0,278\". */\nexport function fmtCoef(v: number, casas = 3): string {\n  const a = Math.abs(v).toFixed(casas).replace('.', ',')\n  const zero = Number(Math.abs(v).toFixed(casas)) === 0\n  return `${zero ? '' : v < 0 ? MENOS : '+'}${a}`\n}\n\n/** Short axis numbers: 1.500 · 12 mil · 3,5 mi · 2 bi. */\nexport function fmtCompacto(v: number): string {\n  const s = v < 0 ? MENOS : ''\n  const a = Math.abs(v)\n  // One decimal whenever the value has one (12.500 → \"12,5 mil\"): a tick label never rounds its own value.\n  const f = (n: number, suf: string) => `${s}${new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n)}${suf}`\n  if (a >= 1e9) return f(a / 1e9, ' bi')\n  if (a >= 1e6) return f(a / 1e6, ' mi')\n  if (a >= 1e4) return f(a / 1e3, ' mil')\n  return `${s}${new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { maximumFractionDigits: a < 1 ? 3 : a < 10 ? 2 : a < 100 ? 1 : 0 }).format(a)}`\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Hexagonal binning (pointy-top hexagons of circumradius `raio`, in mm)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface Hexagono {\n  cx: number\n  cy: number\n  n: number\n  /** Indices of the points inside, in input order. */\n  indices: number[]\n}\n\n/**\n * Assigns each point to the nearest centre of a fixed hexagonal lattice anchored at (0,0) (exact Euclidean\n * nearest; ties go to the first candidate, so the result is deterministic).\n */\nexport function hexbin(pontos: ReadonlyArray<{ x: number; y: number }>, raio: number): Hexagono[] {\n  const dx = raio * Math.sqrt(3)\n  const dy = raio * 1.5\n  const mapa = new Map<string, Hexagono>()\n  pontos.forEach((p, i) => {\n    const j0 = Math.floor(p.y / dy)\n    let melhor: [number, number] = [0, 0]\n    let dMin = Infinity\n    for (let pj = j0 - 1; pj <= j0 + 2; pj++) {\n      const off = (pj & 1) / 2\n      const base = Math.round(p.x / dx - off)\n      for (let pi = base - 1; pi <= base + 1; pi++) {\n        const d = (p.x - (pi + off) * dx) ** 2 + (p.y - pj * dy) ** 2\n        if (d < dMin - 1e-12) {\n          dMin = d\n          melhor = [pi, pj]\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    const [pi, pj] = melhor\n    const chave = `${pi},${pj}`\n    let h = mapa.get(chave)\n    if (!h) {\n      h = { cx: r3((pi + (pj & 1) / 2) * dx), cy: r3(pj * dy), n: 0, indices: [] }\n      mapa.set(chave, h)\n    }\n    h.n++\n    h.indices.push(i)\n  })\n  return [...mapa.values()].sort((a, b) => a.cy - b.cy || a.cx - b.cx)\n}\n\n/** Vertices of a pointy-top hexagon centred at the origin. */\nexport function verticesHex(raio: number): Array<[number, number]> {\n  const out: Array<[number, number]> = []\n  for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {\n    const a = (Math.PI / 3) * k + Math.PI / 6\n    out.push([r3(raio * Math.cos(a)), r3(raio * Math.sin(a))])\n  }\n  return out\n}\n","// Correlation charts: dispersão (scatter of municipalities), simpson (overall\n// line × one line per group), matriz-correlacao and antes-depois-controle.\n// As in the other method charts, every position comes from the data through\n// a scale in mm; the style's renderer only decides how a mark looks. The\n// coefficient printed on the chart is recomputed from the points it draws, and\n// a published coefficient that disagrees is flagged on the figure.\nimport type { ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { tracar } from '../rough.ts'\nimport {\n  correlacaoDentro,\n  dominioAuto,\n  escalaEixo,\n  fmtCoef,\n  fmtCompacto,\n  hexbin,\n  marcasLog,\n  media,\n  minimosQuadrados,\n  pearson,\n  quantil,\n  spearman,\n  verticesHex,\n  type EscalaEixo,\n  type Hexagono,\n} from './estatistica.ts'\nimport { TEXTO, TEXTO_PEQUENO, larguraTexto, marcasEixo, numeroBr, quebrar } from './geometria.ts'\nimport { cssCor, type CorDado, type CtxPincel, type Pincel } from './pinceis.tsx'\nimport type { EixoDispersao, PontoMunicipio, SpecAntesDepoisControle, SpecDispersao, SpecMatrizCorrelacao, SpecSimpson } from './tiposCorrelacao.ts'\n\nexport interface CtxCorrelacao extends CtxPincel {\n  p: Pincel\n}\n\nexport interface ResultadoCorrelacao {\n  L: { largura: number; altura: number }\n  corpo: ReactNode\n  tabela: { colunas: Array<string | { rotulo: string; numerica?: boolean }>; linhas: Array<Array<string | number>> } | null\n  eixo: { x0: number; x1: number; d0: number; d1: number } | null\n  /** The finding in one sentence, written from the recomputed coefficients. */\n  achado: string\n}\n\nconst n3 = (v: number) => {\n  const r = Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000\n  return Object.is(r, -0) ? 0 : r\n}\n/** Paper-coloured halo behind labels drawn over the cloud. */\nconst HALO = { paintOrder: 'stroke', stroke: 'var(--ty-print-papel)', strokeWidth: 0.6, strokeLinejoin: 'round' } as const\n/** Tolerance between a published coefficient (3 decimals) and the one recomputed from the points. */\nexport const TOLERANCIA_COEFICIENTE = 0.0006\n\n/**\n * Colour of the finding (trend line, named points, group lines): the style's highlight, unless it is almost\n * the ink (pencil styles such as caderno, where the red is the second highlight); then the second highlight.\n */\nexport function corAchado(c: CtxCorrelacao): CorDado {\n  const { destaque, tinta, destaque2 } = c.estilo.cor\n  return distanciaCor(destaque, tinta) < 60 && distanciaCor(destaque2, tinta) >= 60 ?
